addon.name: Apeture
addon.provider-name: Apeture contributors; Estuary foundation by Team Kodi

extension.summary: A luminous home for your games, films and music.
extension.description: Apeture is a controller-first Kodi 21 skin with an original midnight-and-cyan home, six straightforward destinations and Kodi-native media browsing. Install the companion Apeture Games add-on for local game browsing and in-Kodi libretro play. Complete settings, playback and dialogs use the attributed Estuary foundation. No external launcher or background service.
extension.license: GPL-2.0, GPL-2.0-or-later, CC-BY-SA-4.0; bundled font licenses in fonts/
extension.disclaimer: Development foundation for Kodi 21 Omega. Native runtime verification is still required. Original Home layout; remaining windows are based on Estuary. See UPSTREAM.md.
extension.news: 0.1.0: original Apeture home; full pinned Omega Estuary window foundation; native media and games routes.
